_about: Owl mascot puppet poses, made from the approved profile picture. Code later cuts parts (beak, eyelids, wings) and animates them. Fixed seeds: re-running gives the same pictures; to try a different look, change that job's seed. Background is flat green so code can key it out (the owl's face and belly are white, so a white background would not work).
style_lock: Keep EXACTLY the same owl: same thick black hand-drawn ink lines with the same rough texture, black wings and ear tufts, white face and belly, the same big round eyes, the small orange beak, the black graduation cap with its tassel, the same cartoon hand and the same magnifying glass. The owl has EXACTLY TWO wings and nothing else: no extra arms, no extra hands; whenever it holds the magnifying glass, the cartoon hand is the tip of one of those two wings. Same proportions, flat colours, no shading. The whole owl visible including both feet; the feet are BLACK like the wings, never orange. The lens of the magnifying glass is filled with the same cream white as the owl's face. Background: one flat solid bright green colour (#00FF00) and nothing else, no ground line, no orange marks, no shadow.

jobs.name: front-base
jobs.prompt: Show this owl standing upright and facing the viewer, beak closed, eyes open, holding the magnifying glass in its right wing, left wing relaxed at its side.

jobs.name: front-talk
jobs.prompt: Show this owl standing upright and facing the viewer, beak wide open as if talking, eyes open, holding the magnifying glass in its right wing, left wing relaxed at its side.

jobs.name: front-blink
jobs.prompt: Show this owl standing upright and facing the viewer, beak closed, both eyes gently closed, holding the magnifying glass in its right wing, left wing relaxed at its side.

jobs.name: wings-down
jobs.prompt: Show this owl standing upright and facing the viewer with both wings hanging relaxed at its sides and NO magnifying glass in its hands. The magnifying glass lies on the ground beside its black feet.

jobs.name: point-glass
jobs.prompt: Show this owl in a clear pointing pose: body turned slightly to the right, its right arm stretched straight out to the right of the picture holding the magnifying glass at arm's length like pointing at something, eager curious face, left wing relaxed.

jobs.name: shrug
jobs.prompt: Show this owl in a big clear shrug with EXACTLY TWO wings: both of its two wings raised high out to the sides with the wing tips turned up like open palms, shoulders lifted, head tilted, eyebrows raised, small confused beak. It holds nothing: the magnifying glass lies on the ground by its feet.

jobs.name: side-walk
jobs.prompt: Show this owl in a strict side view, a profile facing right: we see only one eye and the beak in profile pointing right, the body seen from the side, walking mid-step with one black foot lifted forward, magnifying glass held in front of it.

jobs.name: wave
jobs.prompt: Show this owl facing the viewer and waving hello with EXACTLY TWO wings: its left wing is raised high above its head, waving; its right wing hangs down at its side and its tip holds the magnifying glass. Happy squinting eyes.
